_comment: Copy to models.json and edit; set MODEL_CONFIG=models.json to use it. Keys starting with '_' are ignored (JSON has no comments). 'defaults' is the shared base; each alias merges over it. Prefer 'auth_token_env' (names the env var holding the token) over an inline 'auth_token' so no secret lives in the file.

_api_kind_choices.openai-chat: OpenAI Chat Completions and OpenAI-compatible endpoints such as Ollama, vLLM, and OpenRouter.

_cloud_sandbox: If creating models.json is awkward, set MODEL_CONFIG_JSON to this same JSON string in the environment. MODEL_CONFIG_JSON takes priority over MODEL_CONFIG.
